aggregation.order: group means are retained as background outputs; the main figure uses panel-specific maximum-degradation selections documented below

panel_a_selection.rule: Within the supervised ablation, select the Single and Bimodal representations with the largest aggregate mean MAE.

panel_specific_active_learning_selection.rule: Select the poorest mean representation within each category for the metric displayed in that panel: lowest Spearman rho in b, highest integrated MAE in c, and highest final-round MAE in d.

model_training: None; plotting and descriptive aggregation only.
